_meta.purpose_one_liner: Happy-path: domain-scoped narrative; verifies narrative string, memory_count integer, themes array all present.
failure_modes_caught: narrative field absent from response (TS returns 'story' or 'text' instead)
memory_count field absent or wrong type
brief=false path returns summary key instead of narrative key
empty memory store produces crash instead of empty narrative
domain parameter ignored: global memories used instead of domain-scoped
